metadata.title: Higher Groupoids of Gauge Potentials in Higher Gauge Theories admitting Weights
metadata.abstract: We construct an explicit small model for the $\infty$-groupoid of null-concordances of higher gauge curvatures by algorithmically trivializing their nonlinear Bianchi identities. More precisely, for a finite-type Sullivan minimal Bianchi algebra equipped with positive integer weights, we organize weighted potentials and higher gauge parameters at each fixed curvature into an $\infty$-groupoid whose gauge transformations are linear in the parameters. We prove that this model is naturally equivalent to the $\infty$-groupoid of null-concordances through an intermediate total-form model, with explicit projection and section maps and simplicial homotopies. When nonempty, its connected components form a torsor for the degree-zero cohomology of an associated weighted gauge complex, and its higher homotopy groups are computed by the higher cohomology of this complex.

analysis.breakthrough: 把特定非线性高阶规范数据的同伦结构变为可计算线性复形。
analysis.limitations: 有限型、极小及正权是构造前提；不保证固定曲率总有势，torsor陈述有非空条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
